description: This source file defines a minimal API endpoint for retrieving a catalog item by its ID in an ASP.NET Core application. It contains the class `CatalogItemGetByIdEndpoint`, which implements routing and handling logic for a GET request, utilizing dependency injection, repository pattern, and DTO construction.

classes.name: CatalogItemGetByIdEndpoint
classes.description: Defines an API endpoint for retrieving catalog items by ID, supporting routing and asynchronous handling, with injected dependencies for URI composition and data access.

methods.name: AddRoute
